CEREMONY_TIME.method: whole seconds spent on condition-specific setup

CONTRACT_AUTHORING_TIME.method: whole seconds spent authoring or repairing machine contracts

FALSE_REFUSAL_RATE.method: basis points: refused valid actions divided by attempted valid actions

FOLLOW_ON_DRIFT.method: count violations after one standardized follow-on change

REVIEW_REPAIR_TIME.method: whole seconds from initial result to accepted repaired result

UNRELATED_CHANGE_RATE.method: basis points: changed paths outside the declared task surface divided by all changed paths
